organic.title: The Imitation Game: Detecting Human and AI-Generated Texts in ...
organic.snippet: However, distinguishing between human-written and AI-generated text has become a significant task. This paper presents a comparative study, introducing a novel dataset of human-written and LLM-generated texts in different genres: essays, stories, poetry, and Python code. We employ several machine learning models to classify the texts.
